title: Tate McRae debuts first fragrance Tate 01 in partnership with Scent Beauty
summary: The ‘Greedy’ singer has partnered with Scent Beauty, an e-commerce platform for bespoke fragrances, to develop her second-skin scent, Tate 01. The aim is to create a ‘fragrance brand designed to leave a lasting cultural mark’
